what: OpenAI hosted web search tool (Responses API, {"type": "web_search"}), used by CP-DR on sol-medium and sol-high

source.fetched_by: Claude Code session, owner-approved network access to developers.openai.com

quoted.pricing_page_tools_row: Web search (incl. images) $10.00 / 1k calls + Search content tokens billed at model rates.
quoted.pricing_page_tokens: Tokens used for built-in tools are billed at the chosen model's per-token rates.
quoted.guide_billed_action: search, which represents a web search. It will usually (but not always) includes the search queries which were searched. Search actions incur a tool call cost (see pricing).
quoted.guide_other_actions: open_page, which represents a page being opened. Supported in reasoning models. find_in_page, which represents searching within a page. Supported in reasoning models.
quoted.reference_max_tool_calls: The maximum number of total calls to built-in tools that can be processed in a response. This maximum number applies across all built-in tool calls, not per individual tool. Any further attempts to call a tool by the model will be ignored.
quoted.reference_include: web_search_call.action.sources: Include the sources of the web search tool call.
quoted.model_page: gpt-6.1-sol: Tools supported by this model when using the Responses API. Web search: Supported

not_stated: Whether search content tokens appear in usage.input_tokens; the charge assumes they do (the pricing page bills them at model rates). Compare the first paid call with the provider's usage page.
Whether open_page and find_in_page are free; the guide names only search actions as incurring the call cost.
Whether web search runs with store: false; no page fetched here says it does not. The first paid call shows it.
